recon.potential_tc_confusion: Multiple treatments vs single control - risk of comparing treatments to each other instead of to control
recon.sample_size_source: completely randomized block design with four replications per treatment and five trees per replicate... n=4
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract 'Yield (kg tree-1)' from Table 2 for each of the 10 biostimulant treatments vs CON (control). Data reported as mean ±SE with n=4. Use Dunnett's test results to identify significant differences from control. Consider extracting data separately by year if Treatment x Year interaction is significant for yield.
